fieldDefinition:
Situs Jurisdiction.  Jurisidction in which the property is located.  Field updated weekly by query script from Tax Rate Area (TRA) number in Assessor's Master Property Record (MPR) file.  The TRA consists of a 6 digit number.  The first two digits are used to determine the jurisdiction code according to the following table:

TRA:  CODE:  DESCRIPTION
09:  CB:  Carlsbad
NULL:  CN:  County of San Diego
02:  CO:  Coronado
01:  CV:  Chula Vista
11:  DM:  Del Mar
03:  EC:  El Cajon
19:  EN:  Encinitas
04:  ES:  Escondido
14:  IB:  Imperial Beach
15:  LG:  Lemon Grove
05:  LM:  La Mesa
06:  NC:  National City
07:  OC:  Oceanside
17:  PW:  Poway
08:  SD:  City of San Diego
13:  SM:  San Marcos
18:  SO:  Solana Beach
16:  ST:  Santee
12:  VS:  Vista
mappingSource: SanGIS XML attribute definition table, not a REST coded-value domain
nullPolicy: Null situs_juris remains unknown. NULL TRA prefix in the source table does not authorize filling null situs_juris with CN.
